title: Settings
resetConfirm:
Reset all settings to defaults?

Your name and avatar are kept. Graphics and other options go back to factory defaults.
hordeLow: Low — waves on 5 and Mother night ({{final}})
hordeMedium: Medium — brood on 3, weavers on 5, farmers on 7, Mother night (9 / 18+ Hans)
hordeUltra: Ultra — every round, double pack counts
cardsSpare: Runes Only (Spare) — base runes on rounds 2, 4, 6, 8, 10
cardsEvery: Runes Only (Every Round) — base runes every round from round 2
cardsFull: Full — rounds 2–4 runes, 5–7 unit packs, 8–10 spells

sheet.commanderHpFactorNote: scales each commander card’s starting HP for both teams
sheet.strongholdLifelineNote: break one and every pack on that side drops — the round ends there
sheet.strongholdStandardNote: losing it only costs you the forge
sheet.strongholdNoneNote: no Stronghold, so no forge either
sheet.techCostEscalationNote: added to a {{tech}}’s price per {{tech}} already owned of that unit type
sheet.perLostTowerNote: applies to that side’s units only, stacking multiplicatively, while the debuff runs
sheet.debuffDurationNote: −{{step}}s per level above 1; a new tower loss adds its duration on top
sheet.buysPerRoundNote: shared by units and base runes
sheet.baseRuneNote: shop — +{{step}} per purchase; uses one buy slot
sheet.rangedRangeBoostNote: Garrison — all ranged units, this round only
sheet.armySpeedBoostNote: Garrison — whole army, this round only
sheet.flankGraceNote: first flank deploys once flanks open
sheet.levelCostNote: leveling is a purchase, never automatic
sheet.recruitAtLevel2Note: once-per-round switch — new recruits arrive pre-leveled
sheet.commanderSpellNote: Stronghold — only on a commander that knows it
sheet.tierNote: Vanguard — totals, not stacked on top of the previous tier

mpHintSteam: Steam lobbies only. Needs Steam running at launch.
mpHintMatchmaking: Online rooms via PeerJS + server list. Needs internet.
mpHintLan: Local network only (Electron). No internet required.
mpNote: Steam and LAN need the Steam version {{link}}

controlsTouch.head: Touch
controlsTouch.tap: Select, place, or buy — same as a left click
controlsTouch.pinch: Zoom — spread or pinch in any direction, not only vertical
controlsTouch.pan: Both fingers moving together pans the map
controlsTouch.orbit: Orbit: left/right rotates heading, up/down tilts

controlsMouse.head: Mouse
controlsMouse.select: Select a pack, place a carried pack, or drop a rune/tactic
controlsMouse.cancel: Cancel / deselect (clears a carried pack, armed rune, or tactic)
controlsMouse.edgePan: Pan while the cursor sits at the edge of the window

controlsKeyboard.head: Keyboard
controlsKeyboard.heading: Rotate heading
controlsKeyboard.pause: Pause menu. In cinema mode, first restores the HUD.

controlsGamepad.head: Gamepad
controlsGamepad.click: Click. Hold and drag to box-select.

debugHelp.head: Cheats & debug
debugHelp.note: Most spawn/skip cheats are single-player only. Atmosphere keys work in any match (visual). Typed into the field, not chat.
debugHelp.scene: Next atmosphere scene, +1000 supply, +5000 HP both sides, battle timer 500s
debugHelp.spawnAll: Single-player: free-spawn every shop unit, max supply, tactics, and bag runes
debugHelp.spawnAllPlus: Same as Shift+U, plus horde units, pack-level scramble, and up to 3 techs per press
debugHelp.hordePacks: Single-player, deploy phase: extra horde packs (repeat to pile on)
debugHelp.skipRound: Single-player: skip the rest of this round
debugHelp.killStronghold: Single-player, battle phase: destroy the enemy Stronghold where it stands
debugHelp.cinema: Cinema — hide HUD for screenshots. Escape restores it.
debugHelp.material: Cycle material debug: clay → wireframe → normals → off
debugHelp.layers: Toggle visual layers: clouds, distance fog, height mist, forest fog, rain, snow, stars
debugHelp.layersOn: Turn every visual layer back on
